title: Deepavali 2026: All you need to know about Supreme Court-permitted time slots, green crackers and other directives
description: The Supreme Court permitted the bursting of certified green firecrackers between 6 a.m. and 7 a.m. and between 8 p.m. and 10 p.m. on November 7 and November 8, 2026 in Delhi-NCR
